summary: Tested the assessment flow-reorder + industry-selector work on both FreeAuditOffer (Business Technology Assessment) and Cyber Risk Scorecard. All requested behaviors verified working correctly via Playwright + a curl check on /api/leads.
critical_code_review_comments: roiCalculator.js / scorecardRoiCalculator.js / FreeAuditOffer.jsx / CyberRiskScorecard/index.jsx all look clean, well-commented, and correctly wire industry -> hourly rate -> ROI figures.
No mongo _id leakage or sync IO issues observed in the leads POST response.
FreeAuditOffer.jsx is ~630 lines - approaching the 700-line split threshold, worth extracting the results-section JSX into a sub-component in a future pass, but not urgent.
test_credentials: None needed - all tested flows are public
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST leads via UI submissions (company: TestCo, TestCo2, email test@example.com, followup@example.com) - these are lightweight test leads in the leads collection, safe to ignore/cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This session's flow-order + industry-selector + calendar-removal work is verified fully working. Verified: (1) Assessment - Industry asked first then Team Size in same Business Context step, Other reveals text input, Next disabled until other-industry text + team size filled, Construction/Financial Services/Manufacturing each show a tailored industry_specific follow-up question appended after Team Size, Healthcare/Professional Services correctly skip that question. Full flow through contact form to results works, ROI dollar figures correctly scale with industry hourly rate (Construction $955/mo vs Financial Services $1023/mo with identical team-size/manual-hours inputs, ratio matches 42->45 rate exactly). (2) Cyber Risk Scorecard - new Industry step appears before the 12-question quiz with all 6 options + Other custom field, Continue button correctly disabled until filled, quiz proceeds unchanged (12 questions, same MFA/monitoring/backup question text verified), results page ROI assumptions note correctly names the selected industry and its hourly rate (e.g. '~$45/hr...Financial Services'), NO calendar/time-slot booking UI found anywhere on results page, new Yes/No follow-up section works end-to-end (Yes -> contact form -> POST /api/leads -> confirmed state; No -> polite decline message, no form), Retake Assessment correctly resets state back to hero. Did not re-test email-report SMTP send end-to-end (clicked buttons were present and wired but did not wait for actual email delivery given time constraints) - if main agent wants full SMTP verification that would need a dedicated pass. POST /api/leads confirmed still accepts source_page='cyber-risk-scorecard-followup' with empty company/phone strings without erroring (200 response with lead id).
